inspiration.observed_pattern: A multi-CTE ranking pipeline aggregates joined event scores, assigns deterministic ROW_NUMBER ranks, and feeds the derived ranks into an UPDATE while preserving rows that already have a checkpoint.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a league leaderboard refresh. Two CTEs aggregate player points and rank the season standings, then a joined UPDATE fills only missing player ranks; a pre-existing checkpoint remains unchanged and all identifiers, rows, and scoring values are newly authored.

fixture_notes: Players 301 through 304 rank by summed season points with player ID as the tie-breaker. Player 303 already has checkpoint rank 7 and must remain unchanged; the other season players receive computed ranks.
determinism_notes: Season IDs, player IDs, score rows, points, ranking order, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE league_players (player_id INT PRIMARY KEY, player_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, season_id INT NOT NULL, current_rank INT NULL)
CREATE TABLE league_results (result_id INT PRIMARY KEY, season_id INT NOT NULL, player_id INT NOT NULL, points INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO league_players VALUES (301, 'Aster', 2026, NULL), (302, 'Beryl', 2026, NULL), (303, 'Cinder', 2026, 7), (304, 'Dune', 2026, NULL), (305, 'Echo', 2025, NULL)

steps.sql: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE season_rankings AS WITH season_totals AS (SELECT p.player_id, COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points FROM league_players AS p LEFT JOIN league_results AS r ON r.player_id = p.player_id AND r.season_id = p.season_id WHERE p.season_id = 2026 GROUP BY p.player_id), ranked_players AS (SELECT player_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_points DESC, player_id ASC) AS new_rank FROM season_totals) SELECT player_id, new_rank FROM ranked_players
UPDATE league_players AS p JOIN season_rankings AS r ON r.player_id = p.player_id SET p.current_rank = r.new_rank WHERE p.season_id = 2026 AND p.current_rank IS NULL
SELECT player_id, player_name, season_id, current_rank FROM league_players ORDER BY player_id
